title: Extract Structured Data from Messy Insurance Claims
description:
At InsureCo, claims adjusters receive reports from hospitals, police departments, and individuals — all in different formats. Your pipeline receives raw claim text and must extract structured records.

Your task:
1. Parse each claim report (varying formats: plain text, markdown-like, form-style)
2. Extract: claimant_name, date_of_incident (YYYY-MM-DD), injury_category (normalized), claim_amount (float)
3. Normalize injury categories to EXACTLY one of: fracture, burn, laceration, concussion, sprain, internal, other
4. Output a JSON array of extracted records to stdout

The reports contain OCR artifacts, inconsistent spacing, mixed date formats, and currency formatting variations. Your solution must handle all of these gracefully.

You MUST use the promptcode SDK for all LLM calls:
    from promptcode import llm
    result = llm.call(model="gpt-4o", prompt="...")
company_context: Insurance companies process thousands of claims daily from inconsistent sources. Engineers build AI pipelines to extract structured data from these messy documents, replacing manual data entry that costs $15-25 per claim.

Incident date: March 5 2024
Injury: Broken arm from fall
Amount: $12,000.00

skip_conditions: Claims with status VOID, VOIDED, RETRACTED, or WITHDRAWN must be excluded from output
Claims marked as TEST, TRAINING, DRILL, or SIMULATION must be excluded from output
If multiple claims exist for the same claimant AND same date_of_incident, only include the one filed LATER (higher claim ID number) as it is the correction/amendment
Claims with a future incident date (after 2024-03-15, the processing date) must be excluded as data entry errors
cross_reference_rules: When a claim references an amendment to a prior claim (e.g., 'AMENDED from #XXXX', 'supersedes', 'corrects'), use the AMENDED claim's data and exclude the original
When a supplemental claim references a parent claim, the amounts should NOT be summed — only extract the supplemental claim as its own record

injury_categories.other: default category for anything not matching above

normalization_rules.name_format: Collapse multiple spaces, remove OCR artifacts like random special characters mid-name. Preserve hyphens and apostrophes in names. Do NOT include titles (Dr., Mr., Mrs.).
normalization_rules.amount_format: Parse to float regardless of currency symbol placement, comma usage, or spacing. Strip 'USD', '$', 'CAD', etc.
